profile_text.body:
Clearscope describes itself as a discoverability platform for search, aimed at helping customers improve and monitor visibility in Google, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude. Its site presents the product as covering topic research, prompt tracking, and AI content generation and optimization in one place. A feature called Query Discovery takes a topic or a website URL and surfaces the queries that drive traffic across those search and AI systems. The company also offers an AI drafting and editing workflow intended to speed up first drafts and scale content production.

The site's product listing describes Clearscope as content optimization AI with readability scoring and competitor content analysis. The company markets itself around topical authority and ranking in both traditional search and AI answers, and says it serves everyone from startups to the Fortune 500. Testimonials on the site include Ethan Smith, CEO at Graphite, who says Clearscope ties topic research, prompt tracking, and AI content generation and optimization together, and Eda Kavlakoğlu, who says the tool helps rank for less competitive terms and compete for harder ones such as machine learning.

Beyond the product listing and the company's own website, the record holds no litigation and no MCP server entry for Clearscope.
